note: On Mt Rushmore Road at the south edge of Rapid City, on the Hwy 16 run to the memorial. The park is tiered into a hillside: each pad is level, but some areas are harder to reach on foot. RV pads are mostly pull-throughs, alongside cabins, motel rooms and tent sites. Monthly spots are sold all year and are the only stays from October to April. --Claude
